title: Supabase button
description: A medium-weight button: a deep green fill with a faint dark edge, a white fill with a hairline border, or a bare ghost. 38px with 6px corners for heroes, a compact 26px for headers, or a round pill chip. Hover darkens the green or washes the white over 200ms with a soft ease-out.
notes: renders a link when href is set, a button otherwise
icons passed as children are sized to 14px
